description: This file defines the SimpleObserverableGrain class, a grain implementation for Orleans that manages observers and handles asynchronous state updates with logging.

classes.name: SimpleObserverableGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that manages observers and performs asynchronous state updates with logging.

methods.name: SimpleObserverableGrain
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grain with a logger and observer manager.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain activation, logs activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of A and triggers a delayed state update event.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of B and triggers a delayed state update event.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of provided a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to the grain.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from the grain.

methods.name: RaiseStateUpdateEvent
methods.description: Notifies all observers of the current state.
